title: Cecal Bacteria DNA Extraction
author: Shiu-Ming Kuo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tfeejje

steps.title: Weigh cecum and prepare NaCl
steps.instruction: Weigh the cecum material, calculate the volume of 0.9 % NaCl needed for a 1:10 dilution of fecal material to NaCl, and set aside the calculated amount.

steps.title: Add NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Using an autoclaved pipette, add the calculated 0.9 % NaCl solution to the vial containing the cecum material; if the total volume exceeds 0.5 mL, mix briefly with the pipette and split the suspension into two vials.

steps.title: Homogenize sample
steps.instruction: Homogenize the suspension with a Kontes Pellet Pestle Motor placed in an ice bath, moving up and down for 30 seconds (or ~20 seconds for smaller volumes) until no visible particles remain.

steps.title: Centrifuge low speed
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenized suspension at 900 × g for 5 minutes in a cold‑room Eppendorf centrifuge.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube; record OD₆₅₀ as indicated in step 10 (if applicable).

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the remaining suspension at 15,000 × g for 2 minutes to pellet the cells, then remove the supernatant completely with a transfer pipette and a 10 µL pipette, retaining the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in EDTA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 480 µL of 50 mM EDTA.

steps.title: Add mutanolysin and lysozyme
steps.instruction: Add 6 µL of 14,286 U/mL mutanolysin and 120 µL of 40 mg/mL lysozyme to the suspension and gently mix with a lysozyme pipette to weaken the bacterial cell walls.

steps.title: Second cell pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15,000 × g for 2 minutes in the cold‑room centrifuge, discard the supernatant, and retain the pellet.

steps.title: Add Nuclei Lysis solution
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL of Nuclei Lysis Solution (not cell lysis solution) to the pellet and gently pipet to resuspend.

steps.title: Heat lysis at 80 °C
steps.instruction: Turn on a heating block to setting 6.6 (≈80 °C). Incubate the tube at 80 °C for 5 minutes to lyse the cells, then allow the tube to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Add RNase and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase Solution, invert the tube 2–5 times to mix, and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and brief spin
steps.instruction: Cool the sample to room temperature and centrifuge briefly to collect the liquid at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Add Protein Precipitation solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Protein Precipitation Solution to the RNase‑treated lysate, then vortex vigorously at high speed for 40 seconds (solution turns white after ~30 seconds).

steps.title: Incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge to collect DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15,000 × g for 3 minutes in the cold‑room centrifuge and retain the supernatant.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer 700 µL of the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube containing 600 µL room‑temperature isopropanol.

steps.title: Mix and chill
steps.instruction: Gently invert the tube 10 times, then place on a rotator for 10 minutes, followed by incubation at –20 °C for 4 hours.

steps.title: Centrifuge DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15,000 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Carefully pour off the supernatant, drain the tube on clean absorbent paper, add 600 µL room‑temperature 70 % ethanol, and gently invert several times to wash the DNA pellet and tube interior.

steps.title: Centrifuge after ethanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000–16,000 × g for 3 minutes, then discard the ethanol.

steps.title: Second wash and dry
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash (add 600 µL 70 % ethanol, invert) and centrifugation (13,000–16,000 × g, 3 min); drain the tube, allow the pellet to air‑dry for 10–15 minutes (optional 5 minutes in a laminar hood).

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL DNAse/RNAse‑free water, incubate at 65 °C for 1 hour, then at room temperature for 5 hours, periodically tapping the tube; alternatively, rehydrate overnight at 4 °C.
